response.overview: In a lawless town where gold is king and trust can get you killed, one man is feared by every outlaw from Texas to California. His name is Dirty Dan — a ruthless, unpredictable gunslinger with a filthy reputation, a crooked smile, and a talent for getting into trouble. When Dirty Dan rides into the dusty town of Dead Man’s Gulch, he discovers that the local sheriff has put a price on his head, a gang of bandits is hunting him down, and a fortune in stolen gold is buried somewhere in the desert. With bounty hunters closing in and old enemies coming out of hiding, Dan must decide whether to run from his past or become the most notorious outlaw the West has ever seen. But Dirty Dan has one rule: never trust a man with clean boots. Packed with wild shootouts, hilarious one-liners, dangerous outlaws, and unexpected betrayals, Dirty Dan: Outlaw of the Wild West is a gritty Western adventure where the dust is thick, the whiskey is cheap, and nobody rides away clean.
